net_liquidity.text: Net liquidity is $5.77T, -0.04T over ~3 months: roughly flat — neither pushing markets up nor down.

global_cb.text: Fed + ECB + BoJ hold $17.6T (-0.1% in ~3 months): global liquidity is moving sideways.

m2_yoy.text: US M2 is growing 5.7% per year and accelerating: moderate money growth.

yield_curve.text: The 10Y−2Y spread is 0.36% (10Y−3M: 0.93%): positively sloped — the bond market is not pricing a recession.

hy_oas.text: High-yield spreads are at 2.80%: credit markets are calm — investors see low default risk. Complacency risk if this stays extreme.

dollar.text: DXY is at 100.97 (-0.4% in 3 months): the dollar is range-bound — not a major force either way right now.

cpi.text: Inflation is 3.7% (core: 2.8%) and rising: too hot — keeps the Fed hawkish, which pressures both bonds and risk assets.

unrate.text: Unemployment is 4.1% (+0.0pp off the 12-month low): the labor market is strong — supports spending and earnings.

fedfunds.text: The Fed's policy rate is 3.63% vs 5.18% on the 10Y: long rates sit well above the Fed — markets expect rates to stay high or growth/inflation to run hot.

spx.text: S&P 500 is 7.5% above its 200-day average: in an uptrend — trend-followers stay invested above this line.

nasdaq.text: S&P 500 is 9.8% above its 200-day average: in an uptrend — trend-followers stay invested above this line.

vix.text: VIX is at 14.2: normal — markets are functioning without stress.

gold.text: Gold is $4,321/oz (+14.6% in 1 year): moving with real rates and the dollar, as usual.

oil.text: WTI crude is $96 (+53% in 1 year): an oil spike — acts like a tax on consumers and pushes inflation back up.

btc.text: BTC $84,087 is above the 200-day ($70,930) and above the 200-week ($65,609): bull-market structure intact.

mvrv.text: MVRV is 1.54 (43th percentile since 2022): holders are modestly in profit — historically an accumulation zone.

mayer.text: Mayer Multiple is 1.19 (price ÷ 200-day average): above trend but within normal bull-market range.

rainbow.text: BTC sits -0.7σ from its long-term log growth path: below the long-term trend line — cheap relative to Bitcoin's own history.

realized.text: BTC trades 59% above the realized price ($52,873): the average coin is in profit, but not euphorically so.

fng.text: Crypto Fear & Greed is 74/100: greedy — fine in an uptrend, but chasing gets expensive.

stables.text: Stablecoin supply is $312B (+0.3% in 3 months): flat — no fresh inflows, rallies must be funded by rotation.

hashrate.text: Hashrate is at 68% of its all-time high: well below peak — miner capitulation, historically near cycle bottoms.

ethbtc.text: ETH/BTC is 0.0320 (+22.0% in 3 months): ETH is outperforming — risk appetite is broadening beyond Bitcoin (typical mid/late bull phase).

funding.text: BTC funding averages +0.002% per 8h (~+2% annualized): near zero — leverage is balanced.

open_interest.text: BTC open interest ≈ $3.2B (+7% in 30 days): leverage is stable.

long_short.text: 1.31 long accounts per short account on OKX: positioning is balanced.

sth_basis.text: BTC trades +17% vs the short-term holder cost basis ($71,776): recent buyers are in profit, so dips tend to get bought — healthy bull structure.

dominance.text: BTC's share of majors is 72.5% (headline BTC.D: 58.3%), +2.9pp off its 120-day low: capital is favoring Bitcoin first — the classic early-bull pattern before rotation broadens.

dex_volume.text: DEX volume averages $10.4B/day (+45% vs the prior 6 months): on-chain trading is accelerating — real usage confirming the price move.

defi_tvl.text: DeFi TVL is $95B (+38% in 90 days): capital is being redeployed into DeFi — the credit rebuild that powers wealth-creation phases.

etf_flows.text: Spot-BTC ETFs: +2,978M over 7 days, +5,701M over 30 (cumulative $58B since launch): the institutional pipe is net-buying — structural demand under the market.

regime.name: Liquidity tailwind · Risk-on
regime.summary: Central banks are adding liquidity and markets are embracing risk. Historically the most rewarding regime for risk assets — and where crypto has done its best work.
playbook: Historically favored: equities, crypto, high-beta assets
Classic mistake: being under-invested and chasing late

checks.label: Golden cross (50d > 200d)
checks.note: The medium-term trend has turned up through the long-term trend — the classic confirmation that the trend has actually changed.

checks.label: Reclaim the 50-week average
checks.note: Price is above the 50-week line but confirmation wants a few weekly closes above it — a retest of this line is normal.

checks.label: Hold the 200-day as support
checks.note: The line the early bull must defend — losing it voids the setup.

checks.label: New money in profit (price > STH cost basis)
checks.note: Recent buyers are in profit, so dips find buyers — the market-structure foundation of a durable bull.

checks.label: BTC dominance turning up
checks.note: BTC dominance has turned up off its cycle low — the classic early-bull pattern: BTC leads first.

checks.label: Stablecoin supply rebuilding
checks.note: No new dollars yet — the wealth-creation fuel tank isn't filling.

checks.label: Leverage rebuilding after the reset
checks.note: Credit and leverage are coming back after the reset — early wealth-creation behavior.

checks.label: On-chain activity inflecting
checks.note: Real usage is picking up with price — the reflexive loop a quality rally needs behind it.

checks.label: Institutional bid (spot ETF flows)
checks.note: The ETF pipe is net-buying — the structural demand this cycle has that earlier ones didn't.

phase.name: Early Bull
phase.why: Trend reclaimed and 7 of 9 early-bull checks are passing, while price is still 33% below the prior high — the early phase profile.

guide.signature: Trend reclaimed (golden cross, 50-week), BTC leads and dominance rises, recent buyers back in profit, first pockets of speculation return while the crowd is still skeptical.
guide.playbook: Historically the phase where patient positioning in majors and high-conviction themes paid best — accumulation into strength, wide stops, no chasing. The edge is building positions before the crowd believes it.
guide.exit_tell: Graduates into Wealth Creation when stablecoins, credit and on-chain activity expand together and price approaches old highs.
